title: MUCH smaller than I thought it was going to be
text: MUCH smaller than I thought it was going to be. This was smaller than I thought it was going to be (maybe I should have looked at dimensions). The baskets are really small and will only fit really small bottles (shaving cream, travel-sized items, etc.). Many of my bottles don't fit. Another issue is if you are using the middle compartment for soap (like I am), it's really hard to get the soap in and out. It's deep so you have to reach in there to get the soap. Difficult if you have a really high shower head like I do. I wish there was a way to slide the soap in/out from the front. Otherwise, it does seem to be built well and high quality. I just wish I had looked around more before settling on this one.
